name: PCQM4Mv2: Quantum Chemical Property Prediction
description: PCQM4Mv2 is a quantum chemistry molecular benchmark from the OGB Large-Scale Challenge (OGB-LSC). Sourced from PubChemQC, it contains 3,746,619 organic molecules with 2D graph structures and 3D relaxed equilibrium conformers for training instances. The benchmark task is regression predicting the HOMO-LUMO energy gap calculated by Density Functional Theory (DFT), evaluated using Mean Absolute Error (MAE).
